body.title: Prepare a private admission dossier
body.objective: Verify campus requirements and manager/candidate file handling before submission.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and candidate portal with matching API configuration. Separate browser contexts for an administrator, campus-A manager and candidate. Supply accounts and the candidate private link separately; never attach credentials or links as evidence. Use a fresh draft lead and passive synthetic PDF/PNG/JPEG files.

steps.action: As the manager, open the lead dossier, select identity as a required category and save. Attempt submission without an identity file.
steps.expected: Requirements belong to campus A. Submission is refused and the lead remains editable; the missing category is identified.

steps.action: Upload a passive PDF as identity, download it, then archive it while the dossier is a draft.
steps.expected: The private download preserves the filename and content. The archived file is distinguished from live files and cannot satisfy the requirement.

steps.action: Request a candidate link and open the separately supplied link in the candidate context. Upload a synthetic identity file and submit the dossier.
steps.expected: The fragment disappears from the URL. Only this candidate's dossier appears. Submission succeeds and freezes file editing; the manager sees the submitted dossier after refresh.

steps.action: As an administrator, change the current campus requirements after submission, then reopen the submitted dossier.
steps.expected: The submitted snapshot is preserved; configuration changes do not silently invalidate or reopen the submitted dossier.

body.title: Restrict admission decisions to directors and administrators
body.objective: Distinguish dossier preparation, admission authority and enrollment finalization.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP. Separate manager, director and administrator contexts with credentials supplied privately. Two fresh submitted campus-A leads; no actual payment is needed.

steps.action: Open a submitted dossier as the campus manager and inspect the available decisions. Attempt an admitted transition through the manager's authenticated API session.
steps.expected: The manager cannot pronounce admission. The API refuses the transition with 403 and the stored status remains dossier_submitted.

steps.action: Open the first dossier as a director and pronounce admission; repeat on the second dossier as an administrator.
steps.expected: Both authorized decisions succeed and are recorded in status history. No payment prerequisite is imposed.

steps.action: Refresh the manager's dossier view after the authorized admission.
steps.expected: The admitted status and enrollment form appear; the manager can prepare finalization without receiving admission authority.

body.title: Finalize enrollment and preserve retry consistency
body.objective: Verify pending student creation, activation delivery and optional partner commission without duplicate enrollment.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP with one direct admitted lead and one partner-referred admitted lead. Campus A has available student capacity and a live class. Manager credentials supplied separately. External mail may be disabled; use only synthetic contacts and keep activation secrets out of evidence.

steps.action: As the manager, finalize the direct lead with valid birth date, gender, unique username and a live campus-A class.
steps.expected: One pending student is linked to the enrolled lead. Activation is shown once with its delivery state; disabled mail is explicitly skipped. No partner commission is created for this direct lead.

steps.action: Refresh the dossier and replay enrollment with its current revision, then inspect the linked student and activation display.
steps.expected: The same student is returned and no duplicate student or commission is created. Refresh/retry does not reveal the initial activation secret again.

steps.action: Finalize the referred lead using another unique username and inspect its partner commission through the authorized management surface.
steps.expected: The lead, pending student, activation intent and single partner commission agree on the enrollment. No partial success is displayed.

steps.action: On a separate fresh admitted lead, attempt enrollment with an existing username or a class from another campus.
steps.expected: Enrollment is refused without creating a student, commission or activation intent; the lead stays admitted so corrected data can be submitted.

body.title: Isolate dossiers and enforce private access states
body.objective: Verify campus and ownership boundaries, entitlement behavior and candidate recovery after stale or revoked access.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and candidate portal. Separate campus-A manager, campus-B manager, same-campus partner and administrator contexts; two synthetic candidate dossiers. Provide private links and credentials separately. Repeat ERP rendering in light and dark themes and candidate rendering in French desktop and Arabic mobile.

steps.action: Try opening the campus-A management dossier as the campus-B manager and as the same-campus partner; use candidate A's session to request candidate B's file.
steps.expected: All unauthorized reads are refused without disclosing the other dossier or file. Partner lead views contain no private dossier or activation data.

steps.action: Set partner to read_only and then hidden as an administrator. Reload the manager's screen and try a management mutation under each state.
steps.expected: Read-only keeps history readable and refuses the manager's mutation. Hidden removes access. Global administrator behavior follows its existing explicit entitlement exemption.

steps.action: Restore partner, then set public-portal to read_only and hidden in turn. Reload the candidate page and attempt a write.
steps.expected: Read-only permits dossier reading and refuses writes. Hidden clears private data and shows the same invalid-access state as inaccessible content.

steps.action: Restore enabled state. Make a concurrent draft edit before a candidate upload; retry explicitly after the conflict. Then revoke the candidate access and reload.
steps.expected: The conflict refreshes the revision before retry and does not silently repeat the upload. Revocation removes previously displayed data. Private access is absent from persistent browser storage and URL history.

body.title: Archive and permanently remove synthetic admission attachments safely
body.objective: Verify retained storage accounting and existing danger-zone safeguards for applicant files.
body.prerequisites: Owned disposable local synthetic ERP only. A draft lead has a synthetic attachment and another submitted lead has an attachment referenced by its submission snapshot. Authorized manager/admin accounts supplied privately. Obtain file IDs and quota figures through authorized APIs. Never use real applicant documents.

steps.action: Archive the draft attachment and compare campus storage usage before and after archive.
steps.expected: The file becomes archived and stops satisfying live requirements, but retained bytes remain charged to campus storage.

steps.action: Request the archived attachment's danger-zone impact preview and attempt permanent deletion without the required confirmation or fresh authorization.
steps.expected: The preview identifies the attachment. Missing guards refuse deletion and preserve both record and private object.

steps.action: Complete the existing danger-zone confirmation, fresh password and reason controls for the disposable archived attachment; reload storage usage.
steps.expected: Guarded deletion removes the private object and record, records the deletion audit and invalidates cached storage usage. Do not retain password or confirmation credentials in evidence.

steps.action: Try archiving or permanently removing the attachment referenced by the submitted dossier.
steps.expected: The submitted-file safeguard refuses removal and preserves the dossier snapshot and private object. No TTL or unguarded business-record deletion is involved.
